overloads.semanticRole: The DELETE USER command deletes the user whose unique user ID number you pass in userID .

constraints: Only the Designer and Administrator can delete users; the Administrator cannot delete a user created by the Designer.
userID must be a valid user ID number as returned by GET USER LIST; if the account does not exist or was already deleted, error -9979 is generated (catchable via a method installed with ON ERR CALL).
Deleted user names no longer appear in the Users editor (opened via EDIT ACCESS) nor in Design mode; their numbers may be reassigned to new user accounts later.
